Of those 24: 16 were confirmed in-scope, verified, and added to the README/data/papers.json (2607.13646 Human4K, 2607.17977 RynnBrain 1.1, 2607.18154 World Translation, 2607.20061 ReferTrack, 2608.03116 Shooting for Contact, 2608.25308 V-Link, 2608.26505 Closing the Loop on the Poppy Humanoid, 2608.26583 SOLO, 2608.27406 CLAP, 2608.27550 Beyond Data Scaling/VLAct, 2608.28090 Stay Seated, 2608.28213 PAMoR, 2608.29242 AnyWorld, 2608.29487 Blind Dexterity, 2608.29769 Learning Agile Perceptive Traversal, 2608.30832 Dual-Cam PEA Humanoid Ankles). 8 were excluded as out of scope after reading their abstracts: 2607.07420 (Initiation Safety, HRI/social-robot consent paper, no robot-learning contribution), 2607.20834 (Offline RL with Hierarchical Action Chunking, 'humanoid-giant' is just an OGBench maze-task name, no robot platform), 2607.22997 (Real2Sim2Real AMD ROCm, primarily a Franka-arm hardware-stack demo, humanoid mentioned only in passing with no platform/result detail), 2607.25798 (Transformer Transformer robot co-design, hardware validation is a bimanual ALOHA rig, no humanoid-specific result), 2607.26985 (SymmGrid, humanoid is a forward-looking aspiration only, real experiments are arm-manipulation), 2608.16978 (VLCP, no robot platform named at all), 2608.22657 (Physical Agentic AI, LLM orchestration architecture paper, not a learned humanoid control method), 2607.19190 (Agentic Real2Sim, borderline - see separate item below).
